content.div:
Laracon EU 2027 brings together PHP and Laravel developers from around the world in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, from April 5–7, 2027.
The conference features two days of inspiring talks and a dedicated workshop day, covering Laravel, modern PHP development, software architecture, artificial intelligence, performance, testing, and building real-world applications.
Whether you're an experienced Laravel developer or just getting started, Laracon EU offers an opportunity to learn from industry experts, discover new technologies, exchange ideas, and connect with the international PHP and Laravel community.
Join us in Amsterdam for three days of learning, inspiration, and community.
For tickets and more information, visit https://laracon.eu/.
